config.surface.help:
deckent config [--json] [--global] [--lang en|tr]
On a terminal: the /config window (groups, typed search, values chosen from the list, a preview before writing). Elsewhere: only the values set here, the group count and where the rest is.

Inspect
  get [key]             a value; a group as key/value rows (whole document: get --json)
  explain [key]         no key: every key with what it is; a key: description, schema, source, binding (--verbose: internal consumers)
  validate              validate the full effective configuration

Change (policy authorization required; a policy may ask for an approval first — nothing is written until it is allowed)
  set <key> [<json>] [--global] [--expect <digest|absent>] [--scope <id>]   without <json>: choose on a terminal; elsewhere the allowed values are listed
  unset <key> [--global] [--expect <digest|absent>] [--scope <id>]
  --command-id <id>       audit command identity
Use --expect absent to require a missing document. Explain uses the project view; --global is refused. Project is the default write layer. Secrets use deckent secret.
An optional section this installation leaves out (inference_serving, operations) reads as "not defined".
